evals.prompt: Convert the file notes.md in my workspace to a PDF called notes.pdf
evals.expected_output: A valid PDF file at notes.pdf with rendered Markdown content including proper CJK text and emoji

assertions.text: The output PDF file exists and has non-zero size

evals.prompt:
Turn this HTML into a PDF:

Hello

World
evals.expected_output: A PDF file with an h1 heading and a paragraph

assertions.text: The output file is a valid PDF

evals.prompt:
Convert this HTML with Chinese characters but no charset meta tag to PDF:

Hello 你好

World 世界 2026

Save as charset_test.pdf
evals.expected_output: A PDF file where Chinese characters render correctly (not garbled), with '你好' and '世界' displayed properly

assertions.text: The output PDF file exists and has non-zero size

evals.prompt: Merge chart.png and diagram.jpg into a single PDF called report.pdf
evals.expected_output: A PDF file containing both images as pages

evals.prompt: Convert the file data.txt in my workspace to a PDF called data.pdf
evals.expected_output: A valid PDF file at data.pdf with plain text content rendered properly

assertions.text: The output PDF file exists and has non-zero size
